test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**clean**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses hygiene practices and the importance of maintaining cleanliness to prevent the spread of infections.
 
• The appropriate adjective should describe the state of surroundings or people that contributes to promoting good health and preventing diseases.
 
• **"Clean"** fits well as it directly refers to hygiene and keeping oneself and surroundings free from dirt and germs.
 
• Other options like "clear," "close," and "cluttered" do not fit in the context of hygiene and cleanliness related to disease prevention.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Clear" **refers to transparency or free from obstruction, which does not align with the context of hygiene practices.
 
• **"Close" **refers to proximity, which does not make sense in the context of maintaining good health through hygiene.
 
• **"Cluttered"** refers to being messy or disorganized, which directly contradicts the concept of cleanliness described in the passage.
